catalogue.note: An instance of the v1.2 component showing the submitted state: success icon, the filled values on #FBFBFB fields with no stroke, “Combine another?” and a #BABABA Dismiss button, and “Done” in the header. Chrome set the 14, 12 and 10px text and the 16px field text about 1px higher than Figma’s render, so those styles move down 1px: a measured correction, not a Figma value. The status bar names SF Pro Text and renders in the system face.
